security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, code fences, or expected local packaging helpers. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files. One semantic issue remains: init_skill.py does not validate skill_name before using it in filesystem paths.

remediation.issue: Skill name path validation is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths, path separators, dot segments, and names outside a strict hyphen-case pattern before creating directories.

remediation.issue: The package script archives every file under the selected skill folder.
remediation.suggestion: Exclude hidden files, symlinks, build outputs, and secret-like filenames by default, then print the inclusion list before writing the archive.

remediation.issue: Command examples rely on bundled helper scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to inspect local helper scripts before execution and run them only on user-approved paths.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Skill Name Can Escape Target Directory
semantic_findings.description: scripts/init_skill.py joins the requested path with skill_name, but main passes the command-line name without enforcing the printed naming rules. A name with path separators, dot segments, or an absolute path could write generated files outside the intended skill directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly uses command-line skill_name in Path(path).resolve() / skill_name before creating directories. The script prints naming requirements but does not enforce them before filesystem writes.

content.user_title: Create AI Skills with Guided Templates
content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills requires clear structure, metadata, and validation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through planning, creating, validating, and packaging skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required structure of a skill folder and SKILL.md file.
Guides planning for scripts, references, and assets based on real use cases.
Provides a bundled initializer script that creates a template skill folder.
Provides a validation script for frontmatter and naming checks.
Provides a packaging script that builds a distributable zip archive.
Gives iteration guidance for improving a skill after testing.
limitations: The generated skill templates contain placeholders that must be edited manually.
The validation script checks only basic frontmatter and naming rules.
The helper scripts write local files and archives, so paths need review.
The skill does not publish packages to any marketplace or remote service.

use_cases.title: Create a New Skill
use_cases.description: Plan a reusable skill, choose bundled resources, and initialize the folder with starter files.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review structure, update SKILL.md guidance, and remove placeholder resources that are not needed.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Sharing
use_cases.description: Validate required metadata and package the skill into a local distributable archive.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Simple Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a new skill for handling a repeated task. Ask only the key questions needed to define the first version.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize a Skill Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new skill folder for this workflow, then explain which placeholder files I should edit or remove.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Skill Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill and make SKILL.md clearer, shorter, and easier for an AI agent to follow.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Package a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this skill, fix any structure problems, and prepare it for local distribution with a short release checklist.

output_examples.input: I need a skill that helps agents create weekly project status updates.
output_examples.output: A concise skill plan with the intended users, trigger description, required references, and a first SKILL.md outline.

output_examples.input: Initialize a skill for cleaning CSV files and explain what to edit next.
output_examples.output: A new skill folder with starter resources, plus clear next steps for replacing placeholders with real workflow guidance.

output_examples.input: Check whether my skill is ready to package.
output_examples.output: A validation summary, any required fixes, and a local package plan for the finished skill.

best_practices: Define concrete user requests before writing the skill body.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into references.
Delete placeholder resources before packaging the finished skill.
anti_patterns: Do not create a skill around vague or untested workflows.
Do not keep example files that are unrelated to the final skill.
Do not place long reference material directly in SKILL.md.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps create folders, metadata, instructions, and optional resources for reusable AI skills.

faq.question: Does it support Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it generate finished skill content automatically?
faq.answer: It provides templates and workflow guidance. The author still needs to replace placeholders with real instructions.

faq.question: Can it validate a skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled validator checks basic YAML frontmatter, required fields, and naming rules.

faq.question: Can it package a skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled packager validates the skill, then creates a local zip archive.

faq.question: Does it connect to external services?
faq.answer: No evidence found of network access or remote publishing in the reviewed files.
